title: lesson.json
description: One lesson of the interactive tutorial: tutorial/lessons/<id>/lesson.json, beside lesson.md (the text) and project/ (a mopm project with mopm.toml and mopm.lock). The site build reads lesson.md and this file; the sandbox template build takes project/. The lesson id is the directory's name and must be a LessonId. What JSON Schema cannot say (the id, each editable path names a file under project/, no two lessons share an order) is checked by the //:tutorial_lessons target (tests/drivers/tutorial_lessons.zig). Changes are additive only.

LessonId.description: The name of the lesson's directory, and the <lesson> of the page's route /tutorial/<lesson>: lower-case letters and digits in words joined by single hyphens.

ProjectPath.description: A file of the lesson's project, relative to project/ (and to the lesson's directory in the sandbox): segments joined by '/', each of letters, digits, '_', '-' and '.', none empty, '.' or '..' (a segment may start with one '.', as a dotfile does). So no absolute path, no backslash and nothing outside project/.

title.description: The lesson's title, as the tutorial's index and the page's heading show it.

summary.description: One sentence on what the lesson teaches, for the tutorial's index.

order.description: The lesson's place in the tutorial, from 1; no two lessons share one.

editable.description: The files of the project the page shows in an editor, in this order. Each one is written to the sandbox before an action runs.

actions.description: The buttons of the page, each the mopm command it runs in the lesson's directory: `run` always, `test` when the lesson has tests. A command is `mopm run` or `mopm test` and arguments of letters, digits and _ . / = : - separated by single spaces, so it holds nothing a shell would read.
